name: The race is run one hundred times and never confirms twice

statusDetails.message: Request: the same in-flight pair, apartments 12 and 3 both posting Tuesday 17:00 in pukuhuone 8 before either response was read, repeated 100 times. Each run started only after GET /api/schedule showed that slot free; a prior holder was released with POST /api/standing-slots/give-up. Observed counts: one-confirmed 100, both-confirmed 0, neither-confirmed 0. Apartment 12 was the confirmed household on 51 runs and apartment 3 on 49. Every refused response was HTTP 409 reason slot_held. Every run left exactly one posted holder matching the confirmation. Consequence: all 100 runs confirmed exactly one household; none confirmed both; none refused both.
